title: El País (Spain): ownership and publishing chain
summary: El País is the Madrid-based Spanish news publication at elpais.com. Its publisher, Ediciones El País, is wholly owned by Diario El País, which is wholly owned by PRISA Media. The graph stops at the requested three relationship levels.

gaps: The name is ambiguous: other newspapers use El País, including publications in Uruguay and Colombia. This graph selects Spain's elpais.com; it does not combine those separate publications.

The three-level limit includes the publication-to-publisher relationship. PRISA Media's parent and that parent's significant shareholders, voting arrangements and ultimate controllers are outside this graph.

Searches for recent sales did not establish a completed disposal of the Spanish newspaper. The latest detailed ownership observation used is 31 December 2025; the legal notice was last updated in July 2025.
Separate voting or appointment rights were not established within the traced chain. No inference of personal ownership is made from executive or editorial positions.
Wikidata identifiers were not verified. All findings remain unreviewed.
